correctness.rationale: Generic facet intersections give precisely two support values and disjoint half-normal dominance events. Exact sum-simplex decomposition gives B_m E exp(-X_m), with B_m=1/(pi^(m/2)Gamma(m/2+1)). Independently verifiable Dirichlet moment formula yields EDelta=-2/(m+2), EDelta^2=(3m+8)/((m+2)(m+4)), EDelta^3=O(m^-2), EDelta^4=O(m^-2). Bounded fourth-order Taylor remainder proves the e^-1(1+7/(2m)+O(m^-2)) factor. Verified with packaged standard-library script.

value.rationale: Quantifies the previously unmeasured superexponential rarity of a natural face-count defect in Haar central cube sections, including exact dimension-dependent normalization and the first correction. It refines existing expected-face asymptotics E F_d~2d by an explicit extreme-event scale and gives a reusable Dirichlet rare-event method.
